picks.rationale: Both Texas and Tennessee enter this game undefeated with high-powered offenses. Tennessee's 'veer and shoot' system under Josh Heupel is known for its high tempo and ability to generate explosive plays, as evidenced by their 2026 scores of 56, 45, and 42 points in their first three games. Texas boasts a strong offensive line and a potent running game, which will complement Arch Manning's passing attack. While Tennessee's pass rush is formidable, the overall offensive firepower and the Volunteers' fast-paced style of play suggest a high-scoring affair in Knoxville.

This matchup features two of the nation's top defenses, with Iowa ranking first overall and Michigan close behind. Both offenses have shown significant struggles this season, particularly in the passing game, and Michigan's rushing attack has been unexpectedly inefficient. Historical betting trends strongly support the Under, with Iowa going 9-1 to the Under in their last 10 games as a road underdog and the Under hitting in five straight games for Iowa against ranked opponents in September. Given the defensive prowess and offensive limitations of both teams, a low-scoring, grind-it-out Big Ten battle is highly anticipated.

This SEC matchup features two teams looking to rebound from Week 3 losses, which often leads to more conservative play. LSU's high-powered offense under Lane Kiffin is hampered by the season-ending injury to key tight end Trey'Dez Green, impacting their passing game. Texas A&M boasts a strong defense, particularly effective on third downs, and their new offensive line faces a tough test on the road. Both quarterbacks are coming off uneven performances, and Texas A&M's passing game has lacked explosive plays this season. These factors, combined with the pressure of avoiding an 0-2 start in conference play, point towards a game where points will be harder to come by.

picks.game: James Madison Dukes @ Old Dominion Monarchs
picks.rationale: James Madison enters this rivalry game undefeated at 3-0, showcasing a powerful run game and an elite defense that ranks among the nation's best in points allowed and quarterback hurries. Old Dominion, conversely, is 1-2 and has struggled against FBS competition, including a significant loss to Virginia Tech. The Dukes have dominated recent head-to-head matchups, including a commanding 63-27 victory last season. Despite a reported injury to JMU's starting quarterback, their strong rushing attack and defensive prowess should allow them to control the game and cover the 6.5-point spread against a struggling Old Dominion squad.

Utah enters this game with a highly potent offense, averaging 47.3 points per game through their 3-0 start, demonstrating a balanced attack with strong passing and rushing numbers. Their recent scores of 66, 43, and 33 points against various opponents highlight their ability to light up the scoreboard. While Iowa State's defense is undergoing a scheme change and has shown some promise, their offense has struggled with consistent rushing efficiency. Utah's offensive firepower, led by dual-threat quarterback Devon Dampier and a robust running game, should be enough to push this game over the relatively modest total of 47.5 points.
